candidate.answerReason: Each exterior angle measures 180°-150°=30°, and 360°/30°=12 sides.

methods.label: Use the supplementary exterior angle
methods.explanation: Each exterior angle is \(180^\circ-150^\circ=30^\circ\). The number of sides is \(360\div30=12\).
methods.levelReason: This uses Grade 7 supplementary angles and the Grade 8 exterior-angle sum for a regular polygon.
